claim_ceiling: TF-IDF baseline establishes clear floors for each benchmark on real Swiss Federal Supreme Court decisions
evidence_summary: Internal consistency verification confirms all 5 benchmarks execute correctly on 1,200 real BGer decisions. Results match expected TF-IDF characteristics: high AUC-ROC for citation matching (0.9519), catastrophically low boilerplate resistance (0.0113), negative multilingual separation (-0.2374), high stability drift (0.8733), and low hierarchy NMI (0.0283). All claims in report are supported by evidence. No data leakage, benchmark gaming, post-hoc metrics, weak baselines, boilerplate confounding, visual-prettiness bias, or unsupported product claims detected. Honest negative/null work correctly identifies TF-IDF limitations and establishes clear targets for legal-distance lane. Real corpus data unavailable for full recomputation; assessment based on code logic and result consistency.
